name: Woodpile
description: Sawn log ends stacked in a woodpile, every one showing its growth rings around an off-center heart and a drying crack.

code.style: --rule: ( --cx: @r(36, 64)%; --cy: @r(36, 64)%; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(0, 360)deg) scale(@rn(0.8, 1.04, 3)); transform: rotate(@r(0, 360)deg) scale(@rn(0.8, 1.04, 3)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 1%; border-radius: @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% / @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; border-radius: @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% / @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)% @r(44, 56)%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at @var(--cx) @var(--cy), #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 13%), conic-gradient(from @r(360)deg at @var(--cx) @var(--cy), #000 0 346deg, transparent 346deg 360deg); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at @var(--cx) @var(--cy), #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 13%), conic-gradient(from @r(360)deg at @var(--cx) @var(--cy), #000 0 346deg, transparent 346deg 360deg); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
